Monsanto Co New (MON) Shareholder Omni Partners Llp Has Boosted Position; Facebook (FB) Holder Arcadia Investment Management Boosted Its Position
June 1, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Arcadia Investment Management Corp increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 11.25% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Arcadia Investment Management Corp bought 2,547 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 25,190 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.03 million, up from 22,643 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Arcadia Investment Management Corp who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $555.13 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.19% or $4.11 during the last trading session, reaching $191.78. About 22.97 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Omni Partners Llp increased its stake in Monsanto Co New (MON) by 99.56% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Omni Partners Llp bought 54,525 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.93% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 109,293 shares of the agricultural chemicals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $12.75M, up from 54,768 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Omni Partners Llp who had been investing in Monsanto Co New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $56.25 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.04% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $127.46. About 7.37 million shares traded or 81.93% up from the average. Monsanto Company (NYSE:MON) has risen 8.56% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.01% the S&P500.
